summary: Verified score 7.2/10. Not on par: below 7.5, no blocker open. Sensitivity PASS (portrait.png, icon.png, splash.png, closing_ervet_r2_game_x3.png): a closed chalk faceplate with a lit blue star slit and cheek lines, no dark eye holes, no hood or point; the crest is a low transverse bar. M1 (base splash) CONFIRMED major: splash.png shows the raised forearm across the helm, the blade leaving the top edge, a warm tan grade on a cool plate and a posterized cut-out figure. M2 (Quick Jab plays 'dash') is reproduced in content and code (ervet.json:208 present.anim 'dash'; dash 3 m at speed 18 = 0.167 s, ervet.json:180-186; movement.ts:467 takes eff.present.anim; actors.ts:1092-1096 fits the clip to the dash) but DOWNGRADED to minor: it is a ~10-frame window in Hilt form only, and the ult stays readable through its own 1.17 s cast_ult wind-up and leap VFX. m1 corrected: the knuckle tap and a 16 deg twist are authored (ervet.py:2014-2039), and 13.7 cm is measured from the hand.L bone origin (the wrist; hand bone length 0.276 m in ervet.glb), so knuckle contact is plausible; the beat is subdued, not missing. m4 corrected: art/tools/three_snapshot.mjs has no form_ node handling (0 matches for 'form_'; actors.ts:207-222 does it in the game), so three_ervet*.png overlay all blade forms and the 'base blade carries Great seams' / 'Lamplit keeps azure seams' evidence is a tool artifact; what remains is the opaque, non-glass blade at the game camera. m2, m3, m5 confirmed. Frame timing NOT MEASURED (no new render needed; pixels and content checks only).

findings.title: The base splash hides the face, crops the blade and is graded off the character's own palette
findings.what: In splash.png the raised right forearm crosses the helm so the star visor is hidden, the blade exits the top edge, the figure is graded warm tan against the cool blued model, and the posterize finish makes the figure a flat cut-out on the painted plate. Base portrait figure is 60 % warm pixels vs Stillwater 0 % and Lamplit 90 %, so base cards read near the Lamplit skin.
findings.gauge: A LoL base splash is the champion's hero shot: face/mask is the focal point, the weapon is fully in frame, the palette matches the in-game model and the figure shares the scene light.
findings.fix: Re-stage in VALE's own victory beat: blade grounded point-down at the front, both hands on the pommel, helm three-quarters to a cool dawn key with the star visor clear; no warm global grade; replace posterize with the lineup's flat-shade plus ink outline; keep the full blade inside a 40 px margin; re-render the base portrait under the same key.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced on the shipped file. Major is right: it is the first art seen at load and draft and fails the identity read. Not a blocker (no sensitivity or function issue).

findings.title: Quick Jab plays the ult's leap clip squeezed into 0.17 s
findings.what: Hilt-form a1 dash carries present.anim 'dash'; movement.ts:467 passes it as the anim and actors.ts:1092-1096 fits the clip to the dash progress, so the 0.67 s leap (hips to 1.40 m, blade tip to 3.51 m) plays in 0.167 s (3 m at speed 18; shorter on first hit).
findings.gauge: A quick dash-stab in LoL keeps a low forward silhouette distinct from the ultimate leap.
findings.fix: Point effects[0].present.anim at 'cast_a1' (its forward lunge fits the dash progress), or author a low lunge variant in ervet.py with hips at or below 0.9 m; keep the overhead leap on the ult only.
findings.verifierNote: Mechanism reproduced in content and code, but downgraded to minor: the wrong pose is visible for about 10 frames, only in Hilt form, and the ult keeps its own 1.17 s cast_ult wind-up and ervet_ult_leap VFX, so the claimed ult-readability loss is small. Same severity the previous verifier gave it.

findings.title: Showcase idle_lobby sword beat is subdued
findings.what: Blade swing measured at 8.5 deg and tip 1.7 cm over 4 s; the beats read small.
findings.gauge: LoL showcase idles carry a readable personality beat within a few seconds.
findings.fix: Enlarge the authored twist (_grounded twist=16 -> about 40 deg) and the tap recoil/head tilt so they read at card size.
findings.verifierNote: Kept minor but corrected: the knuckle tap and twist ARE authored (ervet.py:2025-2034, tap/tap_up keys at 0.44-0.60). The 13.7 cm is from the hand.L bone origin, i.e. the wrist (hand bone 0.276 m in ervet.glb), so 'the hand never reaches the blade / no tap' is not supported.

findings.title: The blade does not read as glass at the game camera
findings.what: At the match camera the blade is an opaque pale bar with no value gradient or inner edge line.
findings.gauge: LoL glass/crystal weapons read through a value gradient and an inner edge highlight at gameplay zoom.
findings.fix: Paint the base blade as clear glass: darker core, light inner bevel, bright edge line; keep seams for the Great form only.
findings.verifierNote: Severity stays minor but the claim is narrowed. The 'base blade already carries the Great seams' and 'Lamplit keeps the pale blade with azure seams' parts rest on three_ervet*.png, and art/tools/three_snapshot.mjs has no form_ handling (grep 'form_' = 0; the game hides inactive forms at actors.ts:207-222), so those sheets overlay every blade form. That evidence is a tool artifact.
